        uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          node-version: '20'

          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

name: Publish Frontend Types

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.types.json'
      - 'vite.types.config.mts'
      - 'scripts/prepare-types.js'
      - 'src/**/*'
      - '!src/**/*.test.*'
      - '!src/**/*.spec.*'
      - '!src/**/__mocks__/**'
      - '!src/**/fixtures/**'
      - '!src/**/stories/**'
      - '!src/**/test-utils/**'
      - '!src/**/test-helpers/**'
      - '!src/**/test-data/**'
      - '!src/**/test-fixtures/**'
      - '!src/**/test-mocks/**'
      - '!src/**/test-support/**'
      - '!src/**/test-utils/**'
      - '!src/**/test-utilities/**'
      - '!src/**/test-validators/**'

jobs:
  publish-types:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build types
        run: pnpm build:types

      - name: Publish types
        run: |
          echo "Publishing frontend types..."
          # Add your publishing logic here
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
